    AI Overview
    The Mexico vs. Belgium international friendly on March 31, 2026, at Estadio Banorte ended in a 1-1 draw, with both sides utilizing key players, including starting lineups featuring
    Rangel (MEX) and Sels (BEL) in goal. Confirmed lineups featured a 4-3-3 for Mexico and a technical lineup for Belgium aimed at building form for the upcoming 2026 World Cup. 
    Mexico Confirmed Lineup (4-3-3): 
    • Goalkeeper: R. Rangel
    • Defenders: J. Gallardo, J. Vásquez, C. Montes, J. Sánchez
    • Midfielders: E. Lira, A. Fidalgo, O. Pineda
    • Forwards: J. Quiñones, R. Jiménez, B. Gutierrez (or O. Pineda in some reports)
    • Coach: Javier Aguirre 
    Belgium Confirmed Lineup (4-3-3 / 4-2-3-1): 
    • Goalkeeper: M. Sels
    • Defenders: T. Castagne, K. De Winter, N. Ngoy (or Theate), M. De Cuyper
    • Midfielders: A. Witsel, Y. Tielemans, K. De Bruyne (or A. Onana)
    • Forwards: D. Lukébakio, L. Openda, M. Godts
    • Coach: Rudi Garcia 
    Match Highlights & Substitutions 
    • Goalscorers: Dodi Lukébakio scored for Belgium.
    • Key Substitutions: Belgium introduced a five-man change including Jeremy Doku, Amadou Onana, and Charles De Ketelaere to alter the tempo.
    • Context: The match was a high-profile friendly, with both teams testing squad depth, particularly following Belgium's high rotation and Mexico's solid performance against Portugal days prior.
